notes:
v4.6.122 — Find Stocks: multi-model AI panel + better charts

🤖 Stock evaluations now run on the APEX server and are the SAME for everyone. Every AI model with a key (Claude, Gemini, Grok, Llama) gives its own review — shown as clear cards with a rating, confidence and bullish/bearish points, plus an overall consensus. Still refreshed weekly, every Monday.

📈 1D and 1W charts are far denser (many more candles) and now fill the panel: the price axis auto-zooms tight around the data instead of floating as a flat line. Fixed an intraday timezone bug that hid most of the session.

🎨 Cleaned up the Manual tab styling to match the rest of the app.

Update via the in-app banner.
